headline: Royalby
title: Royalby | Queen Blessing Guide | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Royalby is a stage three Wind Aniimo that evolves from Puffby at level sixty two with a Hearty Honeybrew. Queen Blessing costs twenty energy and has an eighteen second cooldown. Puffby Bomb costs twenty energy with a ten second cooldown. Its ultimate All Shall Bow to the Crown has power one hundred. Homeland work is Wind level three. Would you rule with Royalby? Comment below!

scenes.fact: All Shall Bow to the Crown

description: Royalby guide: stage 3 Wind Aniimo from Puffby (Lv. 62, Hearty Honeybrew). Queen's Blessing, Puffby Bomb, the All Shall Bow to the Crown ultimate (power 100) and Wind Homeland work. Checked on aniimo.gg and metabot.gg in November 2026.
